payload.title: Define the adapter contract and skip-with-counter failure policy
payload.description:
Define the source-agnostic adapter contract: discover(roots) for session discovery and extract(session) streaming an AsyncIterable of HumanMessageRecords, never loading whole transcripts into memory (files can exceed 100 MB). Codify the shared failure policy: a missing root means the source is absent (not an error); a malformed line or unknown record type is skipped and counted, never fatal; a parse crash inside an adapter is caught per file and reported while the scan continues.

Done when: the contract types exist and are exported; unit tests demonstrate skip-and-count behavior on malformed input and unknown record types; a missing root exits successfully.
